shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure carved in the round from a block
head with prominent brow/eye region rendered as carved recesses
arms indicated schematically against the body
hands/arms brought toward front of torso
justification: Both depict a frontal, block-like anthropomorphic figure in the round with a large head, schematically indicated eyes/brows and arms folded or bent against the torso, an unusual and specific shared scheme of the standing sculpted personage. However, A is elaborated with an extensive repertoire of incised surface motifs (headdress bands, circular disc/pectoral, curved chest ornaments, belt-like registers) on a tall trapezoidal body, whereas B is a plain, unornamented ovoid head-and-shoulders form whose only depicted features are the face and stubby arms.
